主要内容: Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. appointed Michael L. Schmit as Corporate Controller and Chief Accounting Officer, effective April 22, 2019. Schmit, 46, previously served as Chief Accounting Officer and Corporate Controller at Chart Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ:GTLS) from 2018. He also held various finance and accounting leadership roles at Georgia-Pacific, LLC from 2007 to 2017. In connection with his appointment, Schmit received an offer letter dated March 26, 2019, which includes an annual base salary of $270,000 and a grant of 3,000 restricted shares with a four-year vesting period, contingent on continued employment. The appointment is part of the company's leadership structure and does not directly impact market performance or stock price.
